validation: #89 smoke: an operator chat through gated tools, live model, MuJoCo
environment: hpp-agimus-arm64 (source-built HPP), MuJoCo 3.11, two parts, seed 1; local OpenAI-compatible gateway; messages piped to --chat

messages: assemble parts 1 and 2, and rack the driver at the end
what_happened: write_goal produced the full goal (both holes of both parts, gripper empty, driver racked); planned; ran without being asked to run (fixed: see session 2); part 1 assembled, part 2 failed (injected)
'do part 2 first': add_constraint forbidding clamp 2 for part 2 was REJECTED (no plan finishes without it); the model explained part 1 was already done and re-planned part 2 first
'run it': succeeded (both parts assembled, driver racked)
'why did that step fail?': explained cannot_reach(fixtures/clamp2, part2/h_seat) from the refiner's report, and said the report doesn't explain why the retry worked

messages: assemble parts 1 and 2, and rack the driver at the end
session_2.what_happened: after the rule 'run only when the operator asks': write_goal, set_goal, plan, then 'Nothing has been executed yet. Would you like me to run the plan?'

earlier_run: without the domain in its instructions, the model guessed predicates (racked, stored), refused by set_goal; it now gets the predicates, objects and notes, and a write_goal tool (the goal writer role)
